name: Back Corté
notes: Owner's description: slow, quick, quick, slow, the lead stepping straight back and closing on the last slow, turning a quarter to the left over the last two steps; from the end of Closed Promenade into closed hold. Standard name; the owner's version differs from the book, which starts on the lead's right and has a side step on 3: here the lead starts on his left (Closed Promenade leaves him on his right), every travelling step goes back, and the third is slightly to the side. His third step curves round outside his standing foot. 2/4: a slow is one beat. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).

label.lead: back and to the side, turning
